issue.title: Four-week Daily Stats revisit: keep metrics that changed a decision, hide the rest
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-6l.6 (note #3); planned in plan:202610/daily_stats.md rollout phase.

After four weeks of review-journal data (the journal starts with the first ]s walk after the writer shipped, expected 2026-10-12), review the Daily Stats metrics with Bryan: keep the metrics that changed a decision during weekly prunes, hide the rest through `stats.hide` / `stats.overview` in ~/.config/bob/config.yml, and only then consider whether goals belong anywhere (goals and targets are explicitly out of scope for v1). Output: config changes and, if warranted, a decision record via /sase_memory_write.

task_type_fields.proposal: After four weeks of review-journal data, review the Stats metrics with Bryan, hide the ones that changed no decision, and only then consider goals.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: It needs four weeks of real use and Bryan's judgment; the epic could only ship the instrument.
